top_ideas.description: An AI-powered automation tool that helps freelancers and small businesses streamline their social media posting, expense tracking, and time tracking processes.
top_ideas.timing: Now, as more people work remotely and seek to automate repetitive tasks, the demand for simple yet effective tools is on the rise.
top_ideas.validationMethod: Conduct a survey of 100 freelancers and small business owners to gauge interest in automating social media posting and expense tracking, with a focus on user pain points and willingness to pay.
top_ideas.monetization: TaskGenie will generate revenue through subscription-based plans, starting at $9.99/month for basic features and increasing to $29.99/month for premium features with AI-driven insights and reporting.
top_ideas.targetPersona: Freelancers and small business owners who spend too much time on manual tasks, prioritize productivity and efficiency, and are willing to invest in tools that save them time and reduce errors.
mvpFeatures: Automated social media posting across multiple platforms
Simple expense tracking with categorization and tagging
Basic time tracking with reporting capabilities
